api/MyAgents.Agents.GuardrailMiddleware..title: Class GuardrailMiddleware | MyAgents Community Documentation
api/MyAgents.Agents.GuardrailMiddleware..summary: Class GuardrailMiddleware Namespace MyAgents.Agents Assembly MyAgents.Agents.dll Middleware that applies a ordered sequence of IGuardrailPolicy checks to each agent turn's output. On the first violation the output is replaced with the policy's ReplacementMessage (or a generic fallback if none is supplied) and no further policies are evaluated. public sealed class GuardrailMiddleware : IAgentMiddleware Inheritance object GuardrailMiddleware Implements IAgentMiddleware Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks Streaming is buffered, not incremental: the whole turn is accumulated, the policies are evaluated against it, and only then is the outcome yielded. This is required for correctness — text already handed to a caller cannot be retracted, and IGuardrailPolicy is a whole-turn contract (for example MaxLengthGuardrailPolicy needs the total length), so per-chunk vetoing cannot honour it. A violating turn therefore emits only the replacement message; the clean prefix that preceded the violation is never released. The cost is latency parity with the blocking path: an agent using guardrails receives no token-by-token streaming. That is the deliberate trade — a content-safety check that leaks because of a latency preference is the wrong default. InvokeStreamingAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) Invokes the middleware for a streaming turn. The default implementation delegates to InvokeAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) and yields the result as a single chunk, so existing middleware participates in streaming without any changes. Remarks A middleware that relies on this default narrows the stream to a single chunk: the chunks are accumulated into the shape a blocking turn would have produced (see AgentOutputAccumulator), the blocking InvokeAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) path runs once against that result, and the outcome is yielded at the end of the turn. Callers receive the full accumulated content, but not incrementally — token-by-token delivery requires overriding this method.

api/MyAgents.Agents.QuarantineSessionVio.summary: Class QuarantineSessionViolationHandler Namespace MyAgents.Agents Assembly MyAgents.Agents.dll Quarantines the session and aborts when a canary is confirmed; leaves Suspicious findings non-blocking so heuristics can be measured on real traffic before they are trusted. This is the default handler. public sealed class QuarantineSessionViolationHandler : ICanaryViolationHandler Inheritance object QuarantineSessionViolationHandler Implements ICanaryViolationHandler Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks A confirmed canary has no legitimate reason to appear in output or in a tool argument, so the conversation is already compromised by the time it is seen. Quarantine is monotonic: every subsequent turn in that session is refused, which denies an attacker the turn-by-turn probing that an open session would allow. Suspicious findings deliberately do not abort. Markdown beacons and high-entropy URLs have false positives; blocking on them by default would break legitimate turns before an operator has had a chance to see what the rate looks like. Constructors QuarantineSessionViolationHandler(ICanaryVault) Creates a handler that quarantines vault on a confirmed violation. public QuarantineSessionViolationHandler(ICanaryVault vault) Parameters vault ICanaryVault The session vault to quarantine. api/MyAgents.Agents.html.summary: Namespace MyAgents.Agents Classes AgentChannelFeature Feature that wires an IAgentChannel into the agent's session DI overlay, making it available to tools and middleware via context.Services.GetService<IAgentChannel>(). AuditOnlyViolationHandler Never blocks: records every finding to telemetry and lets the turn proceed. Intended for a shadow-mode rollout, so trigger rates can be measured on real traffic before enforcement. BlocklistGuardrailPolicy Flags turns whose output contains any of the configured blocked phrases (case-insensitive). CanaryDefenseFeature Opt-in egress defense: issues a per-session canary, instructs the model to treat it as a secret, and refuses any turn or tool call that would carry it (or a configured heuristic signal) out of the process. CanaryDefenseOptions Tuning for CanaryDefenseFeature. Detection and observability — how a violation is reacted to is decided by ICanaryViolationHandler. CapabilityFeature Feature that declares one or more IAgentCapability entries for an agent. Capabilities are stored on Capabilities so that orchestrators, routers, and tooling can discover what the agent supports at runtime without inspecting the full feature list. CapabilityRouter Single-hop LLM-based router. Given a task description and a set of candidate AgentDefinitions, calls the LLM once to select the best agent. CapabilityRouterResult The result of a single-hop routing decision. ContextWindowFeature Feature that adds ContextWindowMiddleware to the agent pipeline. Trims the incoming message history on every turn so the inner pipeline never sees more messages than the configured window allows. DelegateToSubagentTool Tool that enables an agent to synchronously delegate a specialized task to a subagent and receive its distilled execution result. EmptyResponseGuardrailPolicy Flags turns whose combined output is empty or contains nothing but whitespace. This policy is always included in the default GuardrailsFeature configuration. FallbackFeature Feature that wires a FallbackMiddleware into the agent pipeline. ForkSubagentTool Tool that enables an agent to fork a subagent task asynchronously in the background. FunctionCallingFeature Enables framework-level function calling for runtimes that return tool-call envelopes as assistant messages instead of invoking tools natively. GetSubagentTaskStatusTool Tool that allows an agent to check the status or retrieve the result of an asynchronously forked subagent task. GroupChat A group chat where all registered agents receive each message and take turns responding. This is the simplest multi-agent pattern — round-robin or random selection among agents. GroupChatOptions Configuration for GroupChat. GroupChatResult Result of a GroupChat run. GuardrailMiddleware Middleware that applies a ordered sequence of IGuardrailPolicy checks to each agent turn's output. On the first violation the output is replaced with the policy's ReplacementMessage (or a generic fallback if none is supplied) and no further policies are evaluated. GuardrailsFeature Feature that adds content-safety guardrails to the agent pipeline. HierarchicalSubagentDispatcher Hierarchical subagent dispatcher that manages child agent sessions, isolated context execution, delegation depth recursion guards, and background task forking. InMemoryTokenCostTelemetrySink In-memory accumulator of model routing cost telemetry records. LoggingFeature Feature that adds logging middleware to the agent pipeline. LoggingMiddleware Middleware that logs agent turn execution. MaxDelegationDepthExceededException Exception thrown when a recursive subagent delegation exceeds the maximum allowable depth. MaxLengthGuardrailPolicy Flags turns whose combined output text exceeds maxLength characters. MemoryFeature Feature that wires an IMemoryStore into the agent session. After contributing, the store is available to middleware and tools via context.Services.GetService<IMemoryStore>(). ModelCandidate A registered model candidate available for adaptive multi-model routing. ModelFeature Declares a preferred model for the current agent. ModelPricing Pricing specifications for a model candidate (USD per 1,000,000 tokens). ModelRoutingCostMetrics Structured telemetry recording for model selection, token consumption, and estimated cost. MultiModelRoutingBuilder Builder for configuring multi-model routing candidates and policies. MultiModelRoutingChatClient Adaptive multi-model routing and token/cost optimizing chat client. Routes turns between Economy, Standard, and Advanced models based on prompt complexity, cascades to fallback models on failure, and tracks tokens and dollar spend against budgets. MultiModelRoutingOptions Configuration options for multi-model routing and token/cost optimization. MultiModelRoutingServiceExtensions Service collection extensions for registering multi-model routing and token/cost optimization. MyAgentsActivitySource Framework-level OpenTelemetry activity source. Emits spans under the "MyAgents" source name, complementing MEAI's "Microsoft.Extensions.AI" source which covers the LLM call layer. MyAgentsOtelExtensions Extension methods for registering MyAgents telemetry with OpenTelemetry. Designed to work with both the standard OTel SDK and .NET Aspire's automatic OTLP export pipeline. PromptRegistryFeature Feature that wires a PromptRegistry into the agent session and optionally renders selected templates into the agent's system prompt at assembly time. QuarantineSessionViolationHandler Quarantines the session and aborts when a canary is confirmed; leaves Suspicious findings non-blocking so heuristics can be measured on real traffic before they are trusted. This is the default handler. RoutingException Thrown when CapabilityRouter cannot match the LLM response to any registered agent and no fallback policy is configured. SelectorGroupChat A group chat where an LLM selects which agent should speak next based on the conversation context. This is the AutoGen SelectorGroupChat pattern. SelectorGroupChatOptions Configuration for SelectorGroupChat. SelectorGroupChatResult Result of a SelectorGroupChat run. StructuredOutputFeature<T> Feature that enables strongly-typed structured output for an agent, configuring the agent's schema and providing self-correction retries if the response is invalid JSON. StructuredOutputMiddleware<T> Middleware that sets the AgentResponseFormat on each turn and validates/retries if the model response does not conform to T. SubagentDelegationFeature Feature that equips an agent with subagent delegation tools (delegate_to_subagent, fork_subagent, get_subagent_task_status). SubagentOrchestratorBuilder Builder for configuring hierarchical subagent registrations. SubagentOrchestratorOptions Configuration options for hierarchical subagent orchestration and handoff execution. SubagentResult The final execution outcome and distilled output of a subagent turn or multi-turn execution. SubagentServiceExtensions Service collection extensions for hierarchical subagent orchestration. SubagentTask Task definition dispatched to a specialized subagent. SubagentTaskHandle Handle representing an asynchronously forked subagent task running in the background. TelemetryFeature Feature that adds TelemetryMiddleware to the agent pipeline. Compose alongside LoggingFeature — order determines span nesting. Typically added after LoggingFeature so the OTel span is the outermost wrapper. TelemetryMiddleware Middleware that wraps each agent turn in an OpenTelemetry Activity span. Tags emitted (MyAgents convention): agent.session_id — from AgentTurnContext.SessionId agent.turn.tool_calls — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ToolCalls agent.turn.duration_ms — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.TurnDuration Tags emitted (GenAI convention): gen_ai.operation.name — "chat.completion" gen_ai.request.model — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ModelId gen_ai.response.model — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ModelId gen_ai.usage.input_tokens — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.PromptTokens gen_ai.usage.output_tokens — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.CompletionTokens gen_ai.usage.total_tokens — PromptTokens + CompletionTokens On exception, the span status is set to Error with the exception message. TokenBudgetQuotaException Exception thrown when a turn or session token volume or dollar cost quota is breached. ToolObserverFeature Feature that registers one or more IToolCallObserver instances into the agent assembly so the adapter fires them around every tool invocation. ToolsFeature Feature that registers one or more ITool instances or delegates on an agent definition. Interfaces ISubagentDispatcher Dispatcher contract for delegating, forking, and managing hierarchical subagent executions. ITokenCostTelemetrySink Sink for recording model routing and token cost telemetry records. Enums ModelTier Operational tier and cost class for a language model candidate. api/MyAgents.Core.AgentOutputAccumulator.title: Class AgentOutputAccumulator | MyAgents Community Documentation
api/MyAgents.Core.AgentOutputAccumulator.summary: Class AgentOutputAccumulator Namespace MyAgents.Core Assembly MyAgents.Core.dll Folds the chunks of a streamed turn into the single result a blocking turn would have produced. public static class AgentOutputAccumulator Inheritance object AgentOutputAccumulator Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks A streaming turn emits one chunk per delta, so consecutive chunks typically carry partial fragments of the same message. Treating those fragments as distinct messages breaks anything that reasons about a message as a unit — most importantly IGuardrailPolicy, which is a whole-turn contract (MaxLengthGuardrailPolicy sums message lengths, and the blocklist policy joins messages with a separator that would otherwise sever a phrase spanning two deltas). Folding gives middleware an input whose shape matches the blocking path: one message per contiguous run of same-role fragments, and the last chunk's cumulative duration and token usage. Use this when writing a middleware that overrides InvokeStreamingAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) but must reason about the complete turn rather than individual deltas. Methods Fold(IReadOnlyList<AgentTurnResult>) Folds chunks into a single result, or returns null when the stream produced no chunks at all. public static AgentTurnResult? Fold(IReadOnlyList<AgentTurnResult> chunks) Parameters chunks IReadOnlyList<AgentTurnResult> Returns AgentTurnResult

Returns ValueTask<AgentTurnResult> The result of the turn execution. InvokeStreamingAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) Invokes the middleware for a streaming turn. The default implementation delegates to InvokeAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) and yields the result as a single chunk, so existing middleware participates in streaming without any changes. Override to implement true streaming interception. IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult> InvokeStreamingAsync(AgentTurnContext context, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult>> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) Parameters context AgentTurnContext The turn context. next Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult>> The next streaming middleware or agent in the chain. cancellationToken CancellationToken Cancellation token. Returns IAsyncEnumerable<AgentTurnResult> An async stream of partial results. Remarks A middleware that relies on this default narrows the stream to a single chunk: the chunks are accumulated into the shape a blocking turn would have produced (see AgentOutputAccumulator), the blocking InvokeAsync(AgentTurnContext, Func<AgentTurnContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask<AgentTurnResult>>, CancellationToken) path runs once against that result, and the outcome is yielded at the end of the turn. Callers receive the full accumulated content, but not incrementally — token-by-token delivery requires overriding this method.

api/MyAgents.Core.INonRetryableException.title: Interface INonRetryableException | MyAgents Community Documentation
api/MyAgents.Core.INonRetryableException.summary: Interface INonRetryableException Namespace MyAgents.Core Assembly MyAgents.Core.dll Marks an exception as terminal: ResilienceMiddleware never retries it, regardless of what the configured ITransientErrorClassifier reports. public interface INonRetryableException Remarks Use this for failures where a retry is not merely useless but actively wrong — a security violation, a policy rejection, or any abort whose cause cannot change by re-running the turn. ITransientErrorClassifier answers what tends to be transient from an exception's type. That inference is deliberately coarse: an application may inject a classifier that reports every exception as transient, which would silently replay an abort that must be terminal. Implementing this interface lets the throwing site state what is known to be terminal, and it takes precedence over any classifier. An exception implementing this interface is rethrown without the retry-exhausted metric being recorded, because no retry was attempted — it was never a retry-exhaustion.

api/MyAgents.Core.Security.ICanaryVault..summary: Interface ICanaryVault Namespace MyAgents.Core.Security Assembly MyAgents.Core.dll Holds the canary tokens issued for one session and whether that session has been quarantined. public interface ICanaryVault Remarks A canary is a high-entropy token that has no legitimate reason to appear in agent output or in a tool argument. Because it is meaningless outside the framework, a match is a confirmed exfiltration attempt rather than a heuristic. Quarantine is monotonic: once a session is quarantined, nothing can clear it. A turn that caused a quarantine has already had its conversation poisoned, and leaving the session open would let an attacker probe the detectors turn by turn. Properties Canaries The canary tokens issued for this session. Empty when defense is not configured. api/MyAgents.Core.Workflows.AgentGraph-1.summary: Class AgentGraph<TState> Namespace MyAgents.Core.Workflows Assembly MyAgents.Core.dll A directed graph that routes control flow between named agent nodes based on state transitions. Inspired by LangGraph's compile/run model but scoped to .NET idioms and the MyAgents IAgentSession contract. public sealed class AgentGraph<TState> Type Parameters TState Caller-defined state type. Should be a record or otherwise immutable-by-convention so that nodes return new instances rather than mutating shared state. Inheritance object AgentGraph<TState> Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Remarks v2 capabilities: sequential execution, conditional routing, parallel fan-out via AddFanOutEdge(string, params string[]), streaming execution via RunStreamingAsync(string, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, string?, CancellationToken), time-travel / branch-replay via ResumeFromSnapshotAsync(string, string, string?, CancellationToken) (requires an IGraphHistoryStore), and max-iteration cycle guard. Execution model: primary nodes execute sequentially. After a node completes, if a fan-out edge was registered via AddFanOutEdge(string, params string[]), the listed parallel nodes run concurrently and their states are merged in declaration order before routing continues. The merge delegate is called after every node (sequential or fan-out) to fold the node's returned state into the accumulated graph state. Constructors AgentGraph(IAgentSessionFactory, IEnumerable<AgentDefinition>, Func<TState, TState, TState>, int, IWorkflowCheckpointer?, IGraphHistoryStore?) Creates a new graph. public AgentGraph(IAgentSessionFactory sessionFactory, IEnumerable<AgentDefinition> agentDefinitions, Func<TState, TState, TState> merge, int maxIterations = 100, IWorkflowCheckpointer? checkpointer = null, IGraphHistoryStore? historyStore = null) Parameters sessionFactory IAgentSessionFactory Used to open an IAgentSession for each node invocation. agentDefinitions IEnumerable<AgentDefinition> All agent definitions that nodes in this graph may reference. Each definition's Name must match the agent name passed to AddNode(string, GraphNodeDelegate<TState>). merge Func<TState, TState, TState> Called after every node to fold the node's output state into the accumulated graph state (first argument = current accumulated state, second = state returned by the node that just executed). Common implementations: (_, b) => b — replace: the node's output becomes the new state. (a, b) => a with { Field = b.Field } — selective merge: carry one field forward. maxIterations int Hard upper bound on node transitions before the run is aborted with MaxIterationsReached. Defaults to 100. checkpointer IWorkflowCheckpointer historyStore IGraphHistoryStore Fields End Special sentinel value. Route an edge to End to terminate graph execution normally. public const string End = "__END__" Field Value string Start Conventional name for the first node executed. Not required — you may pass any registered node name as startNode to RunAsync(string, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, string?, CancellationToken). public const string Start = "__START__" Field Value string Methods AddConditionalEdge(string, Func<TState, string>) Adds a conditional edge from fromNode. All must be registered via AddNode(string, GraphNodeDelegate<TState>) before calling RunAsync(string, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, string?, CancellationToken). api/MyAgents.Core.Workflows.AgentLoop.ht.summary: Class AgentLoop Namespace MyAgents.Core.Workflows Assembly MyAgents.Core.dll A standalone ReAct-style agent loop that drives a single agent session until a termination condition is met or maxTurns is exhausted. This is the building block for single-agent reasoning loops that don't require the full WorkflowHost / IWorkflow<TState> machinery. For multi-agent orchestration use WorkflowHost instead. public static class AgentLoop Inheritance object AgentLoop Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Examples var result = await AgentLoop.RunAsync( session, initialMessages: new[] { new AgentMessage("user", "Research AI agent frameworks.") }, termination: ITerminationCondition.Any( new MaxTurnsTermination(maxTurns: 10), new TextMentionTermination("DONE")), maxTurns: 10); Console.WriteLine(result.FinalResult.Output[0].Content); Methods RunAsync(IAgentSession, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, ITerminationCondition, int, Action<AgentTurnResult, int>?, CancellationToken) Runs the agent in a loop until the termination condition is met or maxTurns is exceeded, whichever comes first. public static ValueTask<AgentLoopResult> RunAsync(IAgentSession session, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage> initialMessages, ITerminationCondition termination, int maxTurns = 20, Action<AgentTurnResult, int>? onTurnCompleted = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) Parameters session IAgentSession The agent session to invoke on each turn. initialMessages IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage> The messages to send on the first turn. termination ITerminationCondition Condition checked after each turn. When it returns true the loop stops. Use Any(params ITerminationCondition[]) / All(params ITerminationCondition[]) to combine conditions. maxTurns int Hard upper bound on turns. Defaults to 20. onTurnCompleted Action<AgentTurnResult, int> Optional callback invoked after each turn, before termination is evaluated. Useful for logging or streaming partial results to the caller. cancellationToken CancellationToken Cancellation token. Returns ValueTask<AgentLoopResult> An AgentLoopResult containing all turn results, the final result, the termination reason, and the number of turns completed. RunAsync<TState>(IAgentSession, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, Func<TState, AgentTurnResult, TState>, ITerminationCondition, int, Action<TState, AgentTurnResult, int>?, CancellationToken) Runs the agent in a loop with typed state that is updated by a reducer after every turn. Useful for ReAct-style loops where the agent accumulates structured results (e.g. a research summary, a tool output list) across turns. public static ValueTask<AgentLoopResult<TState>> RunAsync<TState>(IAgentSession session, TState initialState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage> initialMessages, Func<TState, AgentTurnResult, TState> reducer, ITerminationCondition termination, int maxTurns = 20, Action<TState, AgentTurnResult, int>? onTurnCompleted = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) Parameters session IAgentSession The agent session to invoke on each turn. initialState TState The initial value of TState. initialMessages IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage> The messages to send on the first turn. reducer Func<TState, AgentTurnResult, TState> A pure function that merges the current state with the turn result to produce the next state. Called after every turn, before termination is evaluated. termination ITerminationCondition Condition checked after each turn. maxTurns int Hard upper bound on turns. Defaults to 20. onTurnCompleted Action<TState, AgentTurnResult, int> Optional callback invoked after the reducer runs, before termination is checked. Receives the updated state, the raw turn result, and the current turn number. cancellationToken CancellationToken Cancellation token. Returns ValueTask<AgentLoopResult<TState>> An AgentLoopResult<TState> containing all turn results, the final result, the final state, the termination reason, and the number of turns completed. Type Parameters TState Caller-defined state type. Must be JSON-serializable (System.Text.Json) so that it can be checkpointed. Recommend using an immutable record.

api/MyAgents.Core.Workflows.html.summary: Namespace MyAgents.Core.Workflows Classes AdaptationContext Adaptation evaluation context owned by the caller. AdaptationHint Bounded adaptation artifact returned by an adaptation policy. AdaptationResult Result returned by an adaptation policy. AdaptationSteps Explicit helpers for recording adaptation inputs and evaluating hints. AgentGraph<TState> A directed graph that routes control flow between named agent nodes based on state transitions. Inspired by LangGraph's compile/run model but scoped to .NET idioms and the MyAgents IAgentSession contract. AgentLoop A standalone ReAct-style agent loop that drives a single agent session until a termination condition is met or maxTurns is exhausted. This is the building block for single-agent reasoning loops that don't require the full WorkflowHost / IWorkflow<TState> machinery. For multi-agent orchestration use WorkflowHost instead. AgentLoopResult The full output of a completed RunAsync(IAgentSession, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, ITerminationCondition, int, Action<AgentTurnResult, int>?, CancellationToken) call. AgentLoopResult<TState> The full output of a completed RunAsync<TState>(IAgentSession, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, Func<TState, AgentTurnResult, TState>, ITerminationCondition, int, Action<TState, AgentTurnResult, int>?, CancellationToken) call. Extends AgentLoopResult with the final value of TState after all reducer applications. CompositeAdaptationPolicy Aggregates multiple adaptation policies into a single bounded result set. CompositeGoalPrioritizationPolicy Aggregates multiple prioritization policies into a single weighted score. CompositeModelRoutingPolicy Aggregates multiple routing policies into a weighted score. ConsensusCandidate Candidate produced during deterministic consensus. ConsensusResult Result of a deterministic majority vote. ConsensusSteps Explicit helpers for deterministic consensus and majority voting. DefaultAdaptationPolicy Default deterministic adaptation policy. DefaultGoalPrioritizationPolicy Default deterministic prioritization policy. Only ready goals are eligible; higher priority ranks first. DefaultModelRoutingPolicy Default deterministic routing policy. DistributedCacheCheckpointer An IWorkflowCheckpointer backed by any IDistributedCache implementation (e.g. Redis, SQL Server, Azure Blob via Garnet, or in-memory for tests). FeedbackRecord Structured feedback input captured alongside execution outcomes. FileSystemCheckpointer IWorkflowCheckpointer implementation that persists each WorkflowSnapshot as a JSON file on the local file system. FileSystemGraphHistoryStore IGraphHistoryStore implementation that persists GraphSnapshot records as JSON files on the local file system. GoalCollection Lightweight goal container intended to live inside caller-managed workflow or graph state. GoalDefinition Immutable goal specification. GoalPrioritizationContext Context passed to goal prioritization policies. GoalPrioritizationPolicyEntry Weighted policy entry used by CompositeGoalPrioritizationPolicy. GoalPrioritizationResult Result returned from goal prioritization scoring. GoalRecord Runtime goal record with mutable lifecycle state. GoalSteps Workflow helpers for selecting and updating goals. GraphRunResult<TState> The full output of a completed RunAsync(string, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, string?, CancellationToken) call. GraphSnapshot A versioned, immutable point-in-time snapshot of the graph state captured after a node completes execution. Used by the time-travel and branch-replay features of AgentGraph<TState>. GraphStreamEvent<TState> An event yielded by RunStreamingAsync(string, TState, IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, string?, CancellationToken) as each graph node (or parallel fan-out branch) completes. HumanInputRequest Represents a pending or completed human-input request within a paused workflow. HumanInputRequiredException Thrown by RequestHumanInputAsync<TState>(IWorkflowSession<TState>, string, string, CancellationToken) to unwind the workflow execution stack and hand a serializable snapshot back to the caller. The caller pattern is: try { var state = await host.RunAsync(workflow, initialState); } catch (HumanInputRequiredException ex) { // Persist ex.Snapshot — it contains the paused state and the prompt to show the user. // Later, collect the human's reply and resume: var finalState = await host.ResumeWithInputAsync(workflow, ex.Snapshot, humanReply); } InMemoryGraphHistoryStore In-process, in-memory implementation of IGraphHistoryStore. Snapshots are stored for the lifetime of the object and lost when it is garbage-collected. Suitable for testing and single-process deployments; for distributed or durable scenarios replace with a database-backed implementation. OrchestratorOptions Configuration for orchestrated subagent execution. OrchestratorPlan Planned set of orchestration steps. OrchestratorResult Result of a full orchestrated run. OrchestratorStepModel Structured planner output for a single orchestration step. OrchestratorStepResult Result for an executed orchestration step. OrchestratorSteps Explicit orchestration helpers for planner-led subagent execution. OutcomeRecord Structured record of a completed or attempted execution outcome. ReflectionIteration Captures a single reflection iteration. ReflectionOptions Options for running a reflection loop between a generator agent and a critic agent. ReflectionResult Result of a completed reflection loop. ReflectionSteps Workflow helpers for running an explicit generate/critique/refine loop. RoutingCandidate Candidate route that can be selected for the next workflow step. RoutingCapabilityRequirement Simple capability requirement for route selection. RoutingContext Context passed into route selection policies. RoutingDecision Selected route decision. RoutingPolicyEntry Weighted routing policy entry. RoutingScoreResult Result returned from route scoring. RoutingSteps Explicit helpers for workflow-time route selection. SendPacket<TState> Describes a dynamic Send API branch target for AgentGraph<TState>. SqliteCheckpointer SQLite-backed implementation of IWorkflowCheckpointer. Stores workflow snapshots in a local SQLite database for durable persistence. Configures write-ahead logging (WAL) for high throughput. WorkflowHost Hosts and executes IWorkflow<TState> instances with a named registry of agents. Supports sequential, concurrent, and handoff execution patterns. Usage: var host = new WorkflowHost(sessionFactory); host.RegisterAgent("researcher", researcherDefinition); host.RegisterAgent("writer", writerDefinition); await host.RunAsync(myWorkflow, initialState); WorkflowSnapshot A versioned, serializable snapshot of workflow state for checkpoint/resume. WorkflowSteps Orchestration helpers for common workflow patterns. Workflows call these from within their RunAsync implementation. Sequential: steps run one after another, each receiving the prior output Concurrent: steps run in parallel, results collected Handoff: one agent processes and decides which agent to hand off to next Interfaces IAdaptationPolicy Policy that converts structured outcomes and feedback into bounded hints. IGoalPrioritizationPolicy Scores a goal against the current prioritization context. IGraphHistoryCatalog Optional query surface for enumerating graph-history sessions. IGraphHistoryStore Stores a versioned history of GraphSnapshot records, enabling time-travel and branch-replay operations on AgentGraph<TState> runs. IModelRoutingPolicy Scores routing candidates against a workflow context. IWorkflowApprovalContext Optional workflow-session interface that exposes a pending tool-approval request after resume. IWorkflowCheckpointer Persists and restores WorkflowSnapshot objects so that long-running workflows can survive process restarts. api/MyAgents.Core.html.summary: Namespace MyAgents.Core Classes AgentAssembly Assembly context for building an agent. Features contribute to this assembly during the session creation process. AgentCapabilities Built-in well-known capability definitions. Use these constants when declaring or querying agent capabilities so that identifiers are consistent across the codebase. AgentContent Base type for all content parts that can appear in a multi-modal AgentMessage. Core defines the discriminated union; adapter layers map each case to their native content type. AgentDefinition Definition of an agent, composed of features that contribute tools, middleware, and behavior. AgentMessage Represents a message exchanged between agents and the runtime. AgentModelCapability Declares the preferred model ID for an agent. AgentOutputAccumulator Folds the chunks of a streamed turn into the single result a blocking turn would have produced. AgentPipeline Immutable middleware pipeline. Executes middlewares in order, ending with the inner agent. AgentResponseFormat Specifies the expected response format for an agent turn or session. AgentResponseFormat.JsonObjectFormat Generic JSON object response without an enforced schema. AgentResponseFormat.JsonSchemaFormat Schema-constrained JSON response. AgentResponseFormat.TextFormat Unconstrained free-form text response. AgentSessionStructuredExtensions Extensions on IAgentSession for strongly-typed structured output invocations. AgentStructuredTurnResult<T> Strongly-typed structured result returned from an agent turn. AgentTurnContext Context passed to an agent during a turn execution. AgentTurnResult Result of an agent turn execution. AgentTurnServices Services available to an agent during a turn execution. AgentTurnTelemetry Telemetry data captured during an agent turn. AllowAllToolApprovalPolicy Default approval policy that allows tool execution immediately. AsyncSignalApprovalGate Coordinates asynchronous out-of-band approvals (e.g. from webhooks, chat channels, or REST endpoints). AudioAgentContent Audio content part with optional metadata. CallbackToolApprovalGate Delegates tool approval gate evaluation to a user-provided callback delegate. CharacterTokenCounter Simple token counter that approximates 1 token per ~4 characters. This is the well‑known heuristic used by many BPE tokenizers when an exact tokenizer isn’t available. CircuitBreakerMiddleware Middleware that implements the circuit-breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures when a downstream dependency is unhealthy. CircuitBreakerOpenException Thrown when a call is attempted against a circuit that is in the Open state. CircuitBreakerOptions Configuration options for CircuitBreakerMiddleware. ConsolePromptApprovalGate Prompts the operator via standard console input/output for interactive tool approval decisions. ContextWindowMiddleware Middleware that trims the incoming message history before forwarding the turn to the inner pipeline. This prevents context-window overflow on long-running conversations without modifying call-site code. DataAgentContent Arbitrary binary data content part (audio, video, PDF, etc.). DeadLetter A dead-letter record capturing the context and exception of a failed agent turn. DeadLetterFallbackPolicy Enqueues a DeadLetter to the provided queue and returns a fixed fallback message. DefaultAgentSessionFactory Default implementation of IAgentSessionFactory. Builds the assembly once at session creation time and passes it to the runtime, ensuring system prompt and tools flow correctly without duplicate assembly. DefaultTransientErrorClassifier Default error classifier that considers common transient exceptions (HttpRequestException, TimeoutException, IOException) as retryable. DocumentAgentContent Document content part for files such as PDF and Office documents. FallbackMiddleware Middleware that catches exceptions escaping the inner pipeline and delegates recovery to an IFallbackPolicy. Place this at (or near) the outermost edge of the pipeline. FunctionCallingMiddleware Runtime-agnostic tool execution middleware. When the inner agent returns an assistant message containing a supported function-call envelope, the middleware resolves the requested tool from the session ToolCatalog, invokes it, appends a tool message to the conversation, and reinvokes the inner pipeline until the agent returns a normal assistant response. GuardrailViolation Describes a guardrail policy violation returned by EvaluateAsync(IReadOnlyList<AgentMessage>, CancellationToken). ImageAgentContent Binary or base-64 image content part. InMemoryDeadLetterQueue In-memory IDeadLetterQueue backed by a ConcurrentQueue<T>. Intended for testing and local development. InMemoryRunTraceSink In-memory implementation of IRunTraceSink for tests, samples, and local-only scenarios. InMemorySessionApprovalMemory Thread-safe in-memory implementation of ISessionApprovalMemory. InMemoryToolApprovalAuditSink Thread-safe in-memory sink for tool approval audit logging. InMemoryToolApprovalStore In-memory approval storage for tests, samples, and local-only scenarios. MaxTurnsTermination Terminates the loop after a fixed number of turns. MyAgentsServiceExtensions Extension methods for registering MyAgents framework services into an IServiceCollection. MyAgentsTelemetry Shared OpenTelemetry primitives for the MyAgents framework. Core middleware and higher-level features use these names so spans and metrics remain consistent across runtimes and packages. PendingToolApproval A persisted approval record for a tool invocation. PipelineBuilder Builder for registering middleware during agent assembly. PromptBuilder Builder for registering system prompts during agent assembly. RequireApprovalPolicy Approval policy that always requires explicit approval before tool execution. ResilienceMiddleware Middleware that provides retry resilience with exponential backoff and jitter. This should be placed at the outermost edge of the pipeline. ResilienceOptions Configuration options for ResilienceMiddleware. RuleBasedToolApprovalPolicy A rule-based tool approval policy that evaluates tool names, argument patterns, and custom predicates. RunTraceRecord A normalized run-trace event that can be stored locally, exported to CI artifacts, or projected into a local studio view. SlidingWindowTrimmer Trims the message history by removing the oldest non-system messages until the list contains at most maxMessages entries. System messages (role == "system") are always retained at their original position. StaticFallbackPolicy Returns a fixed assistant message on any exception. Never rethrows. TextAgentContent Plain text content part. TextMentionTermination Terminates the loop when any agent message contains a specific phrase. TokenBudgetTermination Terminates the loop when the cumulative token usage exceeds a budget. TokenBudgetTrimmer Trimmer that ensures the total token count for a conversation stays within a specified budget. System messages are never removed and always count toward the budget; non‑system messages are dropped oldest‑first until the remaining history fits. ToolApprovalAuditRecord Structured audit record capturing a tool approval evaluation and its outcome. ToolApprovalDecision Approval decision for a tool invocation. ToolApprovalEvaluator Pipeline orchestrator that evaluates tool approvals against session memory, persistent stores, policies, and interactive gates, producing audit and trace telemetry. ToolApprovalRequest A request to run a tool invocation that may require human or policy approval. ToolApprovalRequiredException Thrown when a tool invocation requires approval before it may run. ToolCatalog Immutable lookup over the tools contributed during agent assembly. Exposed as a session-scoped service so middleware and custom runtimes can resolve tools by name without depending on a specific adapter. ToolCatalogBuilder Builder for registering tools during agent assembly. TurnCapabilities Type-safe, mutable bag for storing arbitrary objects keyed by their type. Used by Capabilities to allow middleware and features to communicate per-turn information without polluting the core context object with lots of strongly typed properties. UriImageAgentContent URI-based image content part. VideoAgentContent Video content part with optional metadata. Interfaces IAgent The core agent contract. All agents implement this interface. IAgentCapability Declares a named capability that an agent supports. Capabilities are informational — they allow orchestrators, routers, and tooling to discover what an agent can do without inspecting its feature list directly. IAgentFeature A feature that contributes capabilities to an agent. Features are composed, not inherited. IAgentMiddleware Middleware that intercepts agent turn execution. IAgentRuntime Runtime responsible for creating agents from definitions. IAgentSession Represents an active agent session with conversation state. IAgentSessionFactory Factory for creating agent sessions from definitions. IContextWindowTrimmer Decides how an AgentMessage sequence should be trimmed when the message history exceeds the configured window. IDeadLetterQueue Abstraction for a dead-letter sink that stores failed agent turns for later inspection, replay, or alerting. IFallbackPolicy Abstraction for handling exceptions that escape the agent pipeline. Implementations decide whether to return a fallback result, enqueue a dead-letter, rethrow, or take any other recovery action. IGuardrailPolicy A single, composable content-safety rule applied to the agent's output after each turn. Multiple policies are evaluated in registration order. INonRetryableException Marks an exception as terminal: ResilienceMiddleware never retries it, regardless of what the configured ITransientErrorClassifier reports. IRunTraceCatalog Optional query surface for enumerating known run IDs from a trace sink. IRunTraceSink Persists normalized execution events for later inspection. ISessionApprovalMemory Maintains active session-scoped tool approval grants (e.g. "Always allow this tool for this session"). ITerminationCondition Determines whether an agent loop or workflow handoff chain should terminate. ITokenCounter Counts tokens in a text string. Implementations may target a specific tokenizer or use a heuristic approximation. IToolApprovalAuditSink Sink for recording and auditing tool approval decisions across the platform. IToolApprovalGate Interactively or asynchronously resolves pending tool approvals (e.g., human-in-the-loop CLI prompts, webhooks, or external signals). IToolApprovalInbox Optional query surface for enumerating approval records across sessions. IToolApprovalPolicy Evaluates whether a tool invocation may proceed immediately or needs approval. IToolApprovalStore Stores pending and resolved tool approvals for workflows, sessions, and local studio inspection. ITransientErrorClassifier Classifies exceptions as transient (retryable) or terminal. Enums ApprovalScope Defines the lifetime and granularity of an approved tool decision. CircuitState Represents the current state of a circuit breaker. RunEventKind Stable execution events emitted by runtimes, middleware, workflows, and tools. ToolApprovalStatus Approval outcome for a tool invocation.

api/MyAgents.Memory.html.title: Namespace MyAgents.Memory | MyAgents Community Documentation
api/MyAgents.Memory.html.summary: Namespace MyAgents.Memory Classes ApproximateTokenCounter Zero-dependency, allocation-free subword token estimator implementing ITokenCounter and modeling modern BPE tokenizers (approx. 4 characters per alphanumeric subword token plus punctuation runs). BM25Index High-performance in-memory BM25 (Best Matching 25) sparse lexical index and ranking engine. Computes probabilistic relevance using term frequency saturation and document length normalization. BatchDocumentIngestionResult Summary of a completed multi-document batch ingestion operation. CachingEmbeddingGenerator Thread-safe, bounded content-hash caching decorator for Microsoft.Extensions.AI.IEmbeddingGenerator<TInput, TEmbedding>. Eliminates redundant embedding generation calls across identical queries and unchanged document chunks. CitationGrounder Extracts and verifies numbered [n] citations in model responses against retrieved memory results. CitationGroundingResult Result of evaluating an assistant response's [n] citation markers against the retrieved context entries injected during a turn. CompositeDocumentReader Composite IDocumentReader that dispatches to registered format readers (HTML, Markdown, plain text, JSON, CSV, source code, or custom binary readers) and extracts heading titles when present. DefaultDocumentIngestor Default implementation of IDocumentIngestor that chunks documents via ITextChunker, performs single-batch embedding generation, replaces prior chunks for the same source URI, and synchronizes the IHybridMemoryRetriever lexical index. DefaultMemoryRetriever Default weighted memory retriever over keyword and semantic stores. DocumentIngestionBuilder Builder for configuring document chunking, token counting, and ingestion services. DocumentIngestionResult Summary of a completed document ingestion operation. DocumentIngestorReaderExtensions Convenience extensions on IDocumentIngestor for ingesting files and streams directly via IDocumentReader. DocumentMetadataKeys Well-known metadata keys attached to ingested document chunks for provenance and citation rendering. EpisodicMemoryEntry Long-term episodic memory record capturing a distilled interaction, session summary, or cross-session milestone. EpisodicMemoryFeature Feature that registers long-term episodic memory tools (recall_past_episodes, save_episodic_fact) into an agent assembly. EpisodicMemoryStore Hybrid episodic memory store providing long-term semantic persistence, cross-session recall, and automated milestone consolidation. EpisodicRecallQuery Query criteria for recalling episodic memories across sessions. GroundedCitation Represents a numbered citation marker (e.g., [1]) referenced in an assistant response and resolved back to its retrieved MemoryEntry. HtmlDocumentReader Zero-dependency IDocumentReader that extracts structured text and titles from HTML documents. Strips <script>, <style>, <svg>, and <noscript> blocks, converts HTML headings (<h1>–<h6>), paragraphs, list items, and line breaks into Markdown-compatible text, and decodes HTML entities. HybridMemoryQuery Query parameters for hybrid semantic + BM25 sparse memory retrieval. HybridMemoryRetriever Hybrid memory retriever combining semantic dense embeddings with BM25 sparse lexical indexing. Merges disparate ranking signals using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) for optimal recall and precision. HybridMemorySearchResult Hybrid search result containing both dense vector and sparse BM25 rank/score metrics. IngestDocument Represents a source document to be chunked, embedded, and upserted into a memory namespace. IngestDocumentTool Tool that allows an agent to ingest or update a document in the knowledge base with provenance metadata. KnowledgeBaseFeature Agent feature that registers knowledge base RAG tools (search_knowledge_base and optionally ingest_knowledge_document) into an agent assembly. MarkdownTextChunker Structure-aware Markdown ITextChunker that splits documents along ATX heading boundaries (#–######), keeps fenced code blocks (``` / ~~~) intact whenever they fit within the configured budget, and optionally prepends active parent heading breadcrumbs to chunks so subsections retain their document hierarchy context. MemoryQuery Weighted query used by the memory retriever. MemoryRetentionPolicy Policy used by memory retention and summarization. MemoryRetentionResult Outcome of a memory retention/compaction pass. MemoryRetentionService Applies retention and summarization policies over a memory namespace. MemoryRetrievalTelemetry Structured telemetry emitted for a memory retrieval request. MemorySearchResult Ranked memory search result with per-signal scores. MemoryServiceExtensions DI helpers for ranked retrieval, hybrid BM25/vector search, episodic memory, document ingestion, and retention services. RecallEpisodicMemoriesTool Tool that allows an agent to search and recall past long-term episodic memories and interaction history. RecursiveCharacterTextChunker Default ITextChunker implementation that splits text along a hierarchy of paragraph, line, sentence, clause, and word separators before falling back to hard character limits. Supports both character budgets (ChunkSize) and token budgets (MaxTokens) via ITokenCounter. RetrievalAugmentationFeature Feature that injects retrieved memory context into the agent turn before model invocation. RetrievalAugmentationOptions Options for retrieval augmentation. SaveEpisodicFactTool Tool that allows an agent to explicitly record a crucial fact, decision, or milestone to long-term episodic memory. SearchKnowledgeBaseTool Tool that allows an agent to actively search a knowledge base namespace using hybrid semantic + BM25 retrieval and receive numbered citations with provenance metadata. SqliteMemoryStore Durable SQLite-backed implementation of IVectorMemoryStore and IMemoryStoreChangeNotifier. Persists MemoryEntry records, JSON metadata, and pre-normalized float embeddings in a single SQLite database while maintaining an in-memory cache for microsecond-latency SIMD Dot(ReadOnlySpan<float>, ReadOnlySpan<float>) vector search. Also skips redundant embedding generation when upserting an entry whose content is unchanged. TextChunk A contiguous slice of a source document produced by an ITextChunker. TextChunkingOptions Options controlling character-budget and optional token-budget text splitting and chunk overlap. VectorDataMemoryRecord Canonical record model used when persisting MemoryEntry items to a Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.VectorStore or Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.VectorStoreCollection<TKey, TRecord>. VectorDataMemoryStore Adapter that implements IVectorMemoryStore and IMemoryStoreChangeNotifier over any Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.VectorStore or Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData.VectorStoreCollection<TKey, TRecord> (such as Qdrant, pgvector, Azure AI Search, SQLite-vec, or Redis) without coupling MyAgents.Memory to any vendor SDK. VectorMemoryFeature Agent feature that contributes a VectorMemoryStore as the agent's IMemoryStore (exposed via Memory). VectorMemoryStore Vector-backed implementation of IVectorMemoryStore that stores MemoryEntry records with their embeddings in memory, supports high-performance semantic search powered by SIMD-accelerated System.Numerics.Tensors.TensorPrimitives, and provides durable snapshot serialization to and from disk or streams. VectorSearchResult A single result from a vector similarity search. Interfaces IDocumentIngestor Orchestrates text chunking, single-batch embedding generation, provenance metadata tagging, store persistence, and lexical index synchronization for RAG corpora. IDocumentReader Abstraction for extracting normalized text, title, and metadata from streams or files (such as HTML, Markdown, JSON, source code, or custom binary document formats like PDF/DOCX) into an IngestDocument ready for IDocumentIngestor. IEpisodicMemoryStore Store contract for persisting, querying, and consolidating episodic long-term memory. IHybridMemoryRetriever Specialized contract for hybrid dense + BM25 memory retrieval. IMemoryRetriever High-level retrieval service that ranks memories using multiple signals. IMemorySummaryGenerator Summary generator used by retention/compaction workflows. IMemoryTelemetrySink Sink for memory retrieval telemetry records. ITextChunker Splits document text into size-bounded, optionally overlapping chunks. IVectorMemoryStore Extends IMemoryStore with semantic vector search. Implementations use an embedding model to convert text to vectors and find semantically similar entries using cosine similarity or similar metrics. Enums HybridRankingMode Method used to merge dense vector similarity and sparse BM25 lexical signals.

docs/agents/multi-agent-and-subagents.ht.summary: Multi-Agent Teams, Subagents & Cost Routing Complex tasks often benefit from dividing responsibilities across specialized agents. MyAgents.Agents provides hierarchical subagent delegation, multi-agent group chats, capability routing, inter-agent messaging channels, and multi-model cost routing. 1. Hierarchical Subagent Dispatching A parent orchestrator agent can delegate subtasks synchronously (delegate_to_subagent) or fork background tasks (fork_subagent + get_subagent_task_status) using HierarchicalSubagentDispatcher and SubagentDelegationFeature: flowchart TD User["User Request"] --> Parent["Lead Orchestrator Agent"] Parent -->|delegate_to_subagent / fork_subagent| Sub1["web-searcher"] Parent -->|delegate_to_subagent / fork_subagent| Sub2["data-analyst"] Parent -->|delegate_to_subagent / fork_subagent| Sub3["code-reviewer"] Sub1 --> Parent Sub2 --> Parent Sub3 --> Parent Configuring Subagents in Dependency Injection using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; var services = new ServiceCollection(); services.AddMyAgentsChatRuntime(); // Register child subagents and SubagentDelegationFeature services.AddHierarchicalSubagents(builder => { builder .AddSubagent(new AgentDefinition("web-searcher", [searchTools], "Finds up-to-date documentation")) .AddSubagent(new AgentDefinition("data-analyst", [sqlTools], "Analyzes metrics and SQL datasets")) .AddSubagent(new AgentDefinition("code-reviewer", [reviewTools], "Reviews C# code for bugs")) .ConfigureOptions(options => { options.MaxDelegationDepth = 3; options.DefaultTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2); options.PrefixSubagentSessionId = true; }); }); await using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider(); // Attach SubagentDelegationFeature to the parent orchestrator agent var delegationFeature = provider.GetRequiredService<SubagentDelegationFeature>(); var leadAgent = new AgentDefinition("lead-orchestrator", [delegationFeature]); You can also invoke ISubagentDispatcher directly from C# code: var dispatcher = provider.GetRequiredService<ISubagentDispatcher>(); // Synchronous delegation SubagentResult result = await dispatcher.DelegateAsync( new SubagentTask( TaskId: "task-1", TargetAgentName: "data-analyst", Instructions: "Summarize Q3 revenue growth."), cancellationToken); // Or background fork SubagentTaskHandle handle = await dispatcher.ForkAsync( new SubagentTask("task-2", "web-searcher", "Check .NET 10 release notes."), cancellationToken); 2. Multi-Agent Group Chat (GroupChat & SelectorGroupChat) When multiple agents need to collaborate in a shared conversation thread, use GroupChat (deterministic C# speaker selection function) or SelectorGroupChat (LLM-driven speaker selection): Deterministic GroupChat using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; var options = new GroupChatOptions( Agents: [researcherDef, writerDef, reviewerDef], MaxTurns: 6, Termination: new TextMentionTermination("APPROVED")); var groupChat = new GroupChat(options, sessionFactory); GroupChatResult chatResult = await groupChat.RunAsync( initialMessages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Draft a migration guide for NativeAOT.")], selectionFunc: (history, turnIndex) => options.Agents[turnIndex % options.Agents.Count], cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Completed in {chatResult.TotalTurns} turns. Last speaker: {chatResult.LastSpeaker}"); LLM-Coordinated SelectorGroupChat var selectorOptions = new SelectorGroupChatOptions( Agents: [researcherDef, writerDef, reviewerDef], SelectorClient: coordinatorChatClient, SelectorPrompt: "Select the next agent best suited to advance the conversation.", MaxTurns: 8, Termination: new TextMentionTermination("FINAL_SIGN_OFF")); var selectorChat = new SelectorGroupChat(selectorOptions, sessionFactory); SelectorGroupChatResult result = await selectorChat.RunAsync( [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Produce a security audit report.")], cancellationToken); 3. Capability Routing (CapabilityRouter) Use CapabilityRouter to classify an incoming task description and route it to the best-matching AgentDefinition: var router = new CapabilityRouter( chatClient: classifierChatClient, agents: [billingAgentDef, technicalSupportDef, salesAgentDef], fallbackAgentName: "technical-support"); CapabilityRouterResult route = await router.RouteAsync( "My invoice from October shows a duplicate charge.", cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Selected: {route.SelectedAgent.Name} (Reason: {route.Reasoning})"); 4. Adaptive Multi-Model Cost Routing (MultiModelRoutingChatClient) Route turns across model tiers (ModelTier.Economy, ModelTier.Standard, ModelTier.Advanced), enforce per-turn or per-session USD/token budgets (TokenBudgetQuotaException), and automatically cascade to fallback models on transient failures: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; using MyAgents.Agents; services.AddMultiModelRouting(builder => { builder .AddCandidate( modelId: "gpt-4o-mini", client: miniChatClient, tier: ModelTier.Economy, pricing: new ModelPricing("gpt-4o-mini", InputCostPerMillionTokens: 0.15m, OutputCostPerMillionTokens: 0.60m), maxInputTokens: 128_000) .AddCandidate( modelId: "gpt-4o", client: frontierChatClient, tier: ModelTier.Advanced, pricing: new ModelPricing("gpt-4o", InputCostPerMillionTokens: 2.50m, OutputCostPerMillionTokens: 10.00m), maxInputTokens: 128_000, isFallback: true) .ConfigureOptions(options => { options.EnableFallbackCascade = true; options.MaxCostPerTurnUsd = 0.25m; options.MaxCostPerSessionUsd = 5.00m; options.MaxTokensPerSession = 250_000; }); }); Inspect real-time token and cost metrics via ITokenCostTelemetrySink (InMemoryTokenCostTelemetrySink): var costSink = (InMemoryTokenCostTelemetrySink)provider.GetRequiredService<ITokenCostTelemetrySink>(); Console.WriteLine($"Session spend: ${costSink.GetTotalCostUsd("session-1"):F4} ({costSink.GetTotalTokens("session-1")} tokens)");

docs/core/architecture.html.title: Architecture & Execution Lifecycle | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/core/architecture.html.summary: Architecture & Execution Lifecycle MyAgents Community is designed with a strict separation of concerns between agent definitions, feature assembly, middleware pipelines, runtime execution loops, tool invocation policies, and state persistence. Architecture Overview flowchart TD subgraph Client Application App["Host Application / Web API"] Factory["IAgentSessionFactory"] end subgraph Assembly & Definition Definition["AgentDefinition"] Features["IAgentFeature Pipeline"] Assembly["AgentAssembly: Prompts, Tools, Middleware, Capabilities"] end subgraph Turn Execution Loop Session["IAgentSession"] Middleware["AgentPipeline (Middleware Chain)"] Runtime["MyAgents.Runtime.Chat (ChatClientRuntime)"] ChatClient["Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient"] LLM["Model Provider: OpenAI, Ollama, Azure, etc."] end subgraph Governance & Tools Approval["ToolApprovalEvaluator & IToolApprovalPolicy"] Gate["IToolApprovalGate & ISessionApprovalMemory"] ToolRegistry["ToolCatalog (ITool)"] Observers["IToolCallObserver"] end App --> Factory Factory -->|Creates| Session Definition -->|Configures| Assembly Features -->|Contributes| Assembly Assembly --> Session Session --> Middleware Middleware --> Runtime Runtime <--> ChatClient ChatClient <--> LLM Runtime --> Approval Approval <--> Gate Approval -->|Approved| ToolRegistry Runtime --> Observers Core Abstractions 1. AgentDefinition An immutable description of an agent's identity, description, features, and capabilities: using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Memory; var definition = new AgentDefinition( Name: "financial-analyst", Features: [ new PromptRegistryFeature(promptRegistry, "system.analyst"), new ToolsFeature(marketDataTool), new RetrievalAugmentationFeature(new RetrievalAugmentationOptions("sec-filings")), new GuardrailsFeature(), new TelemetryFeature() ], Description: "Analyzes quarterly financial filings with grounded citations."); 2. IAgentFeature & AgentAssembly Features are the primary unit of composition (Features are composed, not inherited). When an agent session is created, every feature's Contribute(AgentAssembly) or ContributeAsync(AgentAssembly, CancellationToken) method populates an AgentAssembly: assembly.Prompts (PromptBuilder): Appends system instructions injected before model invocation. assembly.Tools (ToolCatalogBuilder): Registers ITool implementations or delegate functions. assembly.Pipeline (PipelineBuilder): Adds IAgentMiddleware interceptors around each turn (RAG context augmentation, context window trimming, retries, circuit breakers, structured output validation, guardrails, telemetry). assembly.ToolObservers: Attaches IToolCallObserver listeners for pre/post tool call auditing. assembly.Capabilities: Advertises AgentCapabilities (Tools, Streaming, StructuredOutput, Memory, MultiModal, Telemetry, Channel, Workflow) or AgentModelCapability. assembly.RegisterSessionService<T>(service): Registers session-scoped services accessible via context.Services. 3. IAgentSessionFactory & IAgentSession IAgentSessionFactory (implemented by DefaultAgentSessionFactory) is registered in Dependency Injection via services.AddMyAgentsChatRuntime() or services.AddMyAgents(...). Calling factory.CreateSession(sessionId, definition) or await factory.CreateSessionAsync(sessionId, definition, ct) runs the feature assembly phase and builds the middleware pipeline. Each IAgentSession manages isolated conversation state and implements IAsyncDisposable to clean up session-owned resources (such as MCP connections) when disposed. The Turn Execution Lifecycle When session.InvokeAsync(messages) or session.InvokeStreamingAsync(messages) is called: sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User participant Session as IAgentSession participant Pipeline as AgentPipeline (Middleware) participant Runtime as ChatClientRuntime participant LLM as IChatClient participant Eval as ToolApprovalEvaluator participant Tool as ITool User->>Session: InvokeAsync(messages) Session->>Pipeline: InvokeAsync(AgentTurnContext) Pipeline->>Runtime: InvokeAsync(augmentedContext) loop Model & Tool Loop (up to MaxToolRoundTrips) Runtime->>LLM: GetResponseAsync(history, ChatOptions) LLM-->>Runtime: ChatResponse alt Contains FunctionCallContent Runtime->>Eval: EvaluateAsync(ToolApprovalRequest) alt Approved Eval-->>Runtime: ToolApprovalDecision (Approved) Runtime->>Tool: InvokeAsync(argumentsJson) Tool-->>Runtime: string result Runtime->>Runtime: Notify IToolCallObserver & append FunctionResultContent else Rejected or Pending without Gate Approval Eval-->>Runtime: Rejected / Throw ToolApprovalRequiredException end else Final Assistant Response Runtime-->>Pipeline: AgentTurnResult (Output + AgentTurnTelemetry) end end Pipeline-->>Session: Validated AgentTurnResult Session-->>User: AgentTurnResult Middleware Pipeline Pre-Processing: Registered IAgentMiddleware components execute in order—trimming the context window (ContextWindowMiddleware), injecting hybrid RAG citations (RetrievalAugmentationMiddleware), setting structured output schemas (StructuredOutputMiddleware<T>), and starting OpenTelemetry activities (TelemetryMiddleware). Model Request: ChatClientRuntime converts AgentMessage records (including multi-modal ContentParts) and ITool declarations into Microsoft.Extensions.AI primitives and invokes IChatClient. Tool Call Detection & Parallel Execution: If the model requests one or more tool calls, the runtime evaluates them (supporting concurrent tool calls up to ChatClientRuntimeOptions.MaxParallelToolCalls). Approval & Observation: ToolApprovalEvaluator checks ISessionApprovalMemory, IToolApprovalPolicy, and IToolApprovalGate, recording an audit trail to IToolApprovalAuditSink. Approved calls notify IToolCallObserver.OnToolCallingAsync, execute ITool.InvokeAsync, and notify OnToolCalledAsync. Post-Turn Validation: Output flows back through the middleware pipeline—verifying citation grounding (CitationGrounder), validating JSON schemas (StructuredOutputMiddleware<T>), and checking safety policies (GuardrailMiddleware)—before returning the final AgentTurnResult.

docs/core/prompt-registry.html.title: Prompt Registry & Versioned Templates | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/core/prompt-registry.html.summary: Prompt Registry & Versioned Templates Hardcoding system prompts across dozens of agents makes it difficult to track prompt revisions, run A/B experiments, or inject environment-specific variables. MyAgents.Core.Prompts and MyAgents.Agents provide PromptRegistry, PromptTemplateDefinition, and PromptRegistryFeature for versioned prompt management. 1. Registering Versioned Prompt Templates PromptRegistry stores named, versioned PromptTemplateDefinition records with {VariableName} placeholder rendering: using MyAgents.Core.Prompts; var registry = new PromptRegistry() .Register(new PromptTemplateDefinition( Name: "system.support", Version: "1.0", Template: "You are a support engineer for {ProductName}. Keep answers under {MaxWords} words.", Description: "Initial support prompt")) .Register(new PromptTemplateDefinition( Name: "system.support", Version: "2.0", Template: "You are a senior reliability engineer for {ProductName}. " + "Always cite runbooks and keep answers under {MaxWords} words.", Description: "V2 support prompt with runbook citation requirement")); Resolving and Rendering Templates Directly // Get a specific version IPromptTemplate v1 = registry.Get("system.support", version: "1.0")!; // Or get the latest registered version IPromptTemplate latest = registry.GetLatest("system.support")!; string rendered = latest.Render(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["ProductName"] = "MyAgents Cloud", ["MaxWords"] = "150" }); 2. Attaching PromptRegistryFeature to an Agent PromptRegistryFeature wires a PromptRegistry into the session (assembly.PromptRegistry) and optionally renders a selected template (latest or pinned version) into the agent's system prompt at assembly time: using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; // Render the latest version of "system.support" var latestAgent = new AgentDefinition("support-latest", [ new PromptRegistryFeature( registry, systemTemplateName: "system.support", variables: new Dictionary<string, string> { ["ProductName"] = "MyAgents Community", ["MaxWords"] = "200" }) ]); // Pin a specific version ("1.0") for deterministic regression testing var pinnedAgent = new AgentDefinition("support-v1", [ new PromptRegistryFeature( registry, systemTemplateName: "system.support", systemTemplateVersion: "1.0", variables: new Dictionary<string, string> { ["ProductName"] = "MyAgents Community", ["MaxWords"] = "200" }) ]);

docs/core/sessions-and-turns.html.title: Sessions & Turns | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/core/sessions-and-turns.html.summary: Sessions & Turns An agent interaction in MyAgents Community consists of Sessions (IAgentSession) and Turns (AgentTurnContext / AgentTurnResult). Understanding Sessions An IAgentSession manages an ongoing interaction with an agent definition. It provides: Isolated Pipeline & Capabilities: Assembled prompts, tools, middleware, and session-scoped services (AgentAssembly.SessionServices). Resource Lifetime: Implements IAsyncDisposable and IDisposable so session-owned resources (such as local MCP child processes or network transports) are cleaned up deterministically. Turn Invocation: Blocking (InvokeAsync), strongly-typed structured (InvokeAsync<T>), and streaming (InvokeStreamingAsync) methods. Creating a Session using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; using MyAgents.Core; var factory = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAgentSessionFactory>(); // Synchronous session creation await using var session = factory.CreateSession("user-1001-conversation", definition); // Or asynchronous session creation (recommended when using async features like McpFeature) await using var asyncSession = await ((DefaultAgentSessionFactory)factory) .CreateSessionAsync("user-1002-conversation", definition, cancellationToken); Executing Conversational Turns A turn represents a complete input-to-output cycle: the caller supplies one or more AgentMessage instances, and the runtime executes the middleware pipeline and any model-requested tool round-trips to produce an AgentTurnResult. Standard Invocation (InvokeAsync) Use InvokeAsync when you want the complete final response and telemetry once all tool calls and reasoning steps finish: var input = AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Summarize our quarterly metrics."); AgentTurnResult turn = await session.InvokeAsync([input], cancellationToken); foreach (var message in turn.Output) { Console.WriteLine($"[{message.Role}]: {message.Content}"); } // Inspect turn telemetry Console.WriteLine($"Duration: {turn.Telemetry.TurnDuration.TotalMilliseconds:F0}ms"); Console.WriteLine($"Tool Calls: {turn.Telemetry.ToolCalls}"); Console.WriteLine($"Tokens: {turn.Telemetry.PromptTokens} in / {turn.Telemetry.CompletionTokens} out ({turn.Telemetry.TotalTokens} total)"); You can also customize the AgentTurnContext per turn using the configureContext overload: var turn = await session.InvokeAsync( [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Return the result as a JSON object.")], configureContext: ctx => ctx.Capabilities.Set(AgentResponseFormat.JsonObject), cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Streaming Invocation (InvokeStreamingAsync) Use InvokeStreamingAsync for low-latency interactive applications where response chunks should be rendered as they arrive: var input = AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Draft an email to the engineering team."); await foreach (AgentTurnResult chunk in session.InvokeStreamingAsync([input], cancellationToken)) { foreach (var message in chunk.Output) { Console.Write(message.Content); } } Console.WriteLine(); If you want to fold streamed chunks into a single consolidated AgentTurnResult (summing token counts and concatenating assistant output), use AgentOutputAccumulator.Fold: var chunks = new List<AgentTurnResult>(); await foreach (var chunk in session.InvokeStreamingAsync([input], cancellationToken)) { chunks.Add(chunk); } AgentTurnResult? fullResult = AgentOutputAccumulator.Fold(chunks); Messages, Metadata & Roles AgentMessage is an immutable record supporting correlation metadata and multi-modal content parts: // Simple text message var userMsg = AgentMessage.FromText( role: "user", text: "Hello!", correlationId: "corr-101", threadId: "thread-42", senderId: "user-alice"); // Multi-modal message with text and image bytes var multiModalMsg = AgentMessage.FromParts( role: "user", parts: [ new TextAgentContent("What is shown in this architecture diagram?"), new ImageAgentContent(imageBytes, "image/png") ], textSummary: "What is shown in this architecture diagram?"); Context Window Management & Trimming To prevent long-running conversations from exceeding model token limits, add ContextWindowFeature (or ContextWindowMiddleware directly). System messages are always preserved at the start of the conversation while older non-system messages are trimmed: Sliding Message Count Window using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; var definition = new AgentDefinition("chat-agent", [ // Retains all system prompts plus the most recent 10 user/assistant messages new ContextWindowFeature(maxMessages: 10) ]); Token Budget Trimming Chain .WithTokenBudget(...) or pass a TokenBudgetTrimmer to trim messages based on a maximum token budget: using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Memory; var definition = new AgentDefinition("token-bounded-agent", [ new ContextWindowFeature(maxMessages: 50) .WithTokenBudget(maxTokens: 4000, tokenCounter: ApproximateTokenCounter.Instance) ]);

docs/core/structured-output-and-multimod.title: Structured Outputs & Multi-Modal Inputs | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/core/structured-output-and-multimod.summary: Structured Outputs & Multi-Modal Inputs MyAgents Community supports schema-constrained JSON structured outputs with automatic self-correction retries, as well as multi-modal turns combining text, images, audio, video, and binary documents. 1. Strongly-Typed Structured Outputs Using session.InvokeAsync<T> The AgentSessionStructuredExtensions.InvokeAsync<T> extension method configures the turn's AgentResponseFormat for type T, invokes the session, and deserializes the assistant's response into AgentStructuredTurnResult<T>: using MyAgents.Core; public sealed record CodeReviewReport( string Summary, int SeverityScore, IReadOnlyList<string> Findings, bool ApprovedForMerge); AgentStructuredTurnResult<CodeReviewReport> review = await session.InvokeAsync<CodeReviewReport>( messages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Review the diff in PR #128.")], strict: true, cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Approved: {review.Value.ApprovedForMerge} (Score: {review.Value.SeverityScore})"); foreach (var finding in review.Value.Findings) { Console.WriteLine($"- {finding}"); } Using StructuredOutputFeature<T> with Self-Correction Retries When an agent is dedicated to producing a specific schema—or when working with smaller models that occasionally emit markdown code fences (```json) or invalid JSON—register StructuredOutputFeature<T> (from MyAgents.Agents). StructuredOutputMiddleware<T> automatically: Attaches AgentResponseFormat.ForType<T> to every turn's TurnCapabilities. Strips surrounding markdown code fences if present. Validates that the output deserializes cleanly into T. If deserialization fails, appends a correction prompt containing the JsonException details and retries up to maxValidationRetries times. using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; var definition = new AgentDefinition("invoice-extractor", [ new StructuredOutputFeature<InvoiceSummary>( maxValidationRetries: 2, schemaName: "invoice_summary", schemaDescription: "Extracted line items and totals from an invoice.", strict: true) ]); Custom JSON Schemas (AgentResponseFormat) You can also specify raw JSON schemas or unconstrained JSON object mode on any turn: // Unconstrained JSON object mode var jsonObjectFormat = AgentResponseFormat.JsonObject; // Explicit JSON schema string var customSchemaFormat = AgentResponseFormat.ForJsonSchema( schemaName: "ticket_classification", schemaJson: """ { "type": "object", "properties": { "category": { "type": "string", "enum": ["billing", "technical", "sales"] }, "urgency": { "type": "integer" } }, "required": ["category", "urgency"], "additionalProperties": false } """, strict: true); var result = await session.InvokeAsync( [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Classify: My server is down!")], configureContext: ctx => ctx.Capabilities.Set(customSchemaFormat), cancellationToken: cancellationToken); 2. Multi-Modal Messages (AgentContent) AgentMessage.FromParts lets you combine multiple AgentContent items in a single turn. ChatClientRuntime maps these directly to Microsoft.Extensions.AI content types (TextContent, DataContent, UriContent): Content Type Purpose Key Properties TextAgentContent Natural language text segment Text ImageAgentContent Inline binary image bytes Data, MediaType (e.g. "image/png") UriImageAgentContent Remote or local URI image reference Uri, MediaType AudioAgentContent Audio clip bytes Data, MediaType, Duration, Language VideoAgentContent Video clip bytes Data, MediaType, Duration, Width, Height DocumentAgentContent Named document attachment (PDF, CSV, etc.) Data, MediaType, FileName DataAgentContent Arbitrary binary payload Data, MediaType Example: Sending Text + Image + PDF Document using MyAgents.Core; byte[] screenshotBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("error-dialog.png", cancellationToken); byte[] logFileBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync("crash-report.pdf", cancellationToken); var multiModalMessage = AgentMessage.FromParts( role: "user", parts: [ new TextAgentContent("Diagnose the error shown in this screenshot and crash report."), new ImageAgentContent(screenshotBytes, "image/png"), new DocumentAgentContent(logFileBytes, "application/pdf", "crash-report.pdf") ], textSummary: "Diagnose the error shown in this screenshot and crash report."); var result = await session.InvokeAsync([multiModalMessage], cancellationToken);

docs/execution/durable-runs.html.title: Durable Agent Runs & Batch Execution | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/execution/durable-runs.html.summary: Durable Agent Runs & Batch Execution MyAgents.Runtime.Workers and MyAgents.Runtime.Workers.Sqlite provide a crash-resilient, lease-based background execution engine for long-running agent workloads, batch evaluations, and stateful workflows. Why Durable Runs? In production, agents often execute multi-minute tasks such as crawling documentation, processing batch datasets, or waiting on human approvals. Running these inside an HTTP request is fragile: Container restarts or deployments terminate in-flight turns. Client retries cause duplicate agent executions and wasted token spend. Traffic spikes can overwhelm provider rate limits without scope-based admission throttling. Durable Runs decouple submission from execution using a persistent IAgentRunBackend, fencing tokens, lease heartbeats, and automatic crash recovery.
