DistributedCacheCheckpointer: Persists snapshots in any IDistributedCache (Redis, SQL Server, etc.). using MyAgents.Core.Workflows; var host = new WorkflowHost(sessionFactory) .RegisterAgent("release-writer", writerDefinition); using var checkpointer = new SqliteCheckpointer("workflows.db", tableName: "workflow_snapshots"); var workflow = new ReleasePipelineWorkflow(); WorkflowSnapshot? pausedSnapshot = null; try { await host.RunAsync(workflow, new ReleaseWorkflowState(Version: "v1.0.0"), cancellationToken); } catch (HumanInputRequiredException ex) { // Persist the snapshot while waiting for the human operator pausedSnapshot = ex.Snapshot; await checkpointer.SaveAsync(pausedSnapshot, cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Workflow paused at step '{pausedSnapshot.PendingHumanInput?.StepId}': {pausedSnapshot.PendingHumanInput?.Prompt}"); } // Later (e.g. when webhook arrives), load the snapshot and resume with the human's reply: WorkflowSnapshot? loaded = await checkpointer.LoadAsync(pausedSnapshot!.SessionId, cancellationToken); ReleaseWorkflowState finalState = await host.ResumeWithInputAsync( workflow: workflow, snapshot: loaded!, humanReply: "approve", cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Approved: {finalState.ApprovedByReleaseManager}"); 3. Built-in Multi-Agent WorkflowSteps Inside IWorkflow<TState>.RunAsync, WorkflowSteps provides composable multi-agent execution helpers: WorkflowSteps.RunSequentialAsync(session, agentNames, initialMessages): Chains output from each agent as input to the next agent in sequence. WorkflowSteps.RunConcurrentAsync(session, agentNames, messages): Invokes multiple agents in parallel on the same input and returns all AgentTurnResult responses. WorkflowSteps.RunHandoffAsync(session, firstAgentName, initialMessages, nextAgentSelector, termination, maxHops): Dynamically transfers control between agents based on a selector function until termination or maxHops. WorkflowSteps.RunStreamingBridgeAsync(...): Streams chunks from a source agent while compacting and forwarding the completed message to downstream agents. 4. Hosting Checkpointed Workflows in Durable Workers (WorkflowAgentRunHandler<TState>) MyAgents.Runtime.Workers provides WorkflowAgentRunHandler<TState> to bridge IWorkflow<TState> directly into the durable worker engine (AgentRunWorkerService). When a workflow calls RequestHumanInputAsync or RequestToolApprovalAsync, WorkflowAgentRunHandler<TState> automatically transitions the durable run to AgentRunStatus.WaitingForInput and persists the WorkflowSnapshot in the run's CheckpointJson!

docs/workflows/orchestration-patterns.ht.title: Orchestration Patterns: Loops, Reflection, Consensus & Goals | MyAgents Community Documentation
docs/workflows/orchestration-patterns.ht.summary: Orchestration Patterns: Loops, Reflection, Consensus & Goals MyAgents.Core.Workflows ships ready-to-use building blocks for higher-level agentic reasoning patterns: iterative AgentLoop reductions, planner-worker-synthesizer orchestration (OrchestratorSteps), generator-critic self-refinement (ReflectionSteps), multi-agent majority voting (ConsensusSteps), and dynamic goal prioritization (GoalSteps & AdaptationSteps). 1. Iterative Agent Loops (AgentLoop & ITerminationCondition) AgentLoop.RunAsync repeatedly invokes an IAgentSession, reducing state across turns until an ITerminationCondition is satisfied or maxTurns is reached. Built-in Termination Conditions MaxTurnsTermination(maxTurns) TextMentionTermination(phrase, StringComparison) TokenBudgetTermination(maxTokens) Combinators: ITerminationCondition.Any(...) and ITerminationCondition.All(...) using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Core.Workflows; var termination = ITerminationCondition.Any( new TextMentionTermination("TASK_COMPLETE"), new TokenBudgetTermination(maxTokens: 8000)); AgentLoopResult<int> loopResult = await AgentLoop.RunAsync( session: session, initialState: 0, initialMessages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Iteratively refine the SQL schema until complete.")], reducer: (stepCount, turnResult) => stepCount + 1, termination: termination, maxTurns: 5, onTurnCompleted: (state, turn, idx) => Console.WriteLine($"Completed turn {idx}"), cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Stopped because: {loopResult.Reason} after {loopResult.TurnsCompleted} turns."); 2. Generator-Critic Self-Refinement (ReflectionSteps) ReflectionSteps.RunAsync pairs a generator agent with a critic agent in a feedback loop until the critic approves the candidate output (or MaxIterations is reached): sequenceDiagram participant Gen as Generator Agent participant Critic as Critic Agent loop Up to MaxIterations Gen->>Critic: Candidate Draft Critic-->>Gen: Critique (or "APPROVED") end using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Core.Workflows; var options = new ReflectionOptions( GeneratorAgentName: "code-author", CriticAgentName: "security-reviewer", MaxIterations: 3, ApprovalPredicate: ReflectionSteps.ContainsApprovedCritique); ReflectionResult reflection = await ReflectionSteps.RunAsync( session: workflowSession, options: options, initialMessages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Write a JWT validation middleware in C#.")], cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Approved: {reflection.Approved} in {reflection.IterationsCompleted} iteration(s)."); Console.WriteLine(reflection.FinalCandidate.Output[0].Content); 3. Planner-Worker-Synthesizer (OrchestratorSteps) OrchestratorSteps.RunAsync asks a planner agent to decompose a complex objective into a structured OrchestratorPlan of steps, dispatches steps (sequentially or in parallel batches) to specialized worker agents, and invokes a synthesizer agent to produce the final answer: using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Core.Workflows; var orchestratorOptions = new OrchestratorOptions( PlannerAgentName: "lead-planner", WorkerAgentNames: ["db-specialist", "api-specialist", "frontend-specialist"], SynthesizerAgentName: "tech-lead", MaxSteps: 6, MaxRepairAttempts: 2, AllowParallelExecution: true); OrchestratorResult result = await OrchestratorSteps.RunAsync( session: workflowSession, options: orchestratorOptions, initialMessages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Design an end-to-end audit logging feature.")], cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Executed {result.StepResults.Count} planned steps."); Console.WriteLine(result.FinalResult.Output[0].Content); 4. Multi-Agent Majority Voting (ConsensusSteps) When high reliability is needed for classification or decision-making, ConsensusSteps.RunMajorityVoteAsync queries multiple agents in parallel, extracts each agent's discrete choice, and computes the majority winner (with optional tie-breaker): using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Core.Workflows; ConsensusResult consensus = await ConsensusSteps.RunMajorityVoteAsync( session: workflowSession, agentNames: ["auditor-1", "auditor-2", "auditor-3"], messages: [AgentMessage.FromText("user", "Is this transaction fraudulent? Reply SAFE or FRAUD.")], choiceSelector: turn => turn.Output[0].Content.Trim().ToUpperInvariant(), tieBreaker: tied => tied[0], cancellationToken: cancellationToken); Console.WriteLine($"Winning decision: {consensus.WinningChoice} (Tie broken: {consensus.TieBroken})"); 5. Goal Prioritization & Runtime Adaptation (GoalSteps & AdaptationSteps) For autonomous agents managing a backlog of goals and adapting to runtime outcomes or human feedback: GoalCollection & GoalSteps: Register GoalDefinition items with priorities (Critical, High, Normal, Low), transition statuses (Ready, Active, Blocked, Completed, Failed), and select the highest-scoring ready goal via GoalSteps.SelectNextAsync(goals, policy). AdaptationSteps & DefaultAdaptationPolicy: Record OutcomeRecord and FeedbackRecord entries during execution and call AdaptationSteps.EvaluateAsync(...) to generate AdaptationHint prompt adjustments when outcome scores drop below threshold.

index.html.summary: MyAgents Community Modular, NativeAOT-ready, and provider-neutral AI agent runtime for .NET 10. MyAgents Community is an enterprise-grade agent framework for .NET 10 built on top of Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It provides complete provider neutrality, compile-time NativeAOT tool generation, stateful workflow graphs, restart-recoverable durable worker execution, and hybrid RAG memory with zero vendor lock-in. 🚀 NativeAOT Ready Generate compile-time tool schemas and bindings with MyAgents.Generators. Zero runtime reflection, zero trimming warnings, and near-instant cold starts. Read NativeAOT Guide → 🛡️ Durable Execution & Workflows Background worker leasing, idempotency deduplication, stateful AgentGraph<TState> pipelines, and SQLite crash recovery via MyAgents.Runtime.Workers. Read Durable Runs → 🔍 Hybrid RAG Memory Fused SIMD dense cosine similarity (TensorPrimitives.Dot) and BM25 sparse lexical ranking with zero-dependency document ingestion and grounded citations. Read Hybrid RAG → Quick Start (C#) using Microsoft.Extensions.AI; using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; using MyAgents.Agents; using MyAgents.Core; using MyAgents.Runtime.Chat; // 1. Configure services with your IChatClient and MyAgents runtime var services = new ServiceCollection(); services.AddSingleton<IChatClient>(chatClient); services.AddMyAgentsChatRuntime(); await using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider(); var sessionFactory = provider.GetRequiredService<IAgentSessionFactory>(); // 2. Define an agent with tools var tools = new ToolsFeature() .AddFunction(() => DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("O"), name: "get_time", description: "Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 format."); var definition = new AgentDefinition("assistant", [tools]); // 3. Create a session and run turns await using var session = sessionFactory.CreateSession("session-1", definition); var turn = await session.InvokeAsync([AgentMessage.FromText("user", "What time is it in UTC?")]); foreach (var message in turn.Output) { Console.WriteLine(message.Content); } Package Ecosystem Matrix Install only the modules your workload needs: Package Purpose MyAgents.Core Core interfaces (IAgent, IAgentSession, ITool, AgentDefinition, AgentGraph<TState>, WorkflowHost, approvals, middleware). MyAgents.Runtime.Chat Provider-neutral execution runtime using Microsoft.Extensions.AI.IChatClient. MyAgents.Generators Roslyn incremental source generator for zero-reflection [AgentTool] code emission. MyAgents.Runtime.Workers Long-running durable worker host with lease heartbeats, batch execution, and workflow adapters. MyAgents.Runtime.Workers.Sqlite Transactional SQLite backend for persistent durable runs. MyAgents.Memory SIMD vector store, SQLite/VectorData stores, BM25 inverted index, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and document ingestion. MyAgents.Mcp Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool, prompt, resource, hot-reload, and skill discovery adapters. MyAgents.Agents Subagent dispatching, group chats, guardrails, structured outputs, OpenTelemetry, and model tier routing. MyAgents.Testing Deterministic in-memory test agents, fake sessions, and run backends.
